name: dsh-web-fetch-local
description: `web_fetch` tool backed by local Python urllib (HTTP + SSRF + JSON-LD) and Node-side Turndown + GFM (HTML→Markdown). Reuses DSH's bundled turndown via install.py junction bridge.

scripts.test: python src/fetch.py --url https://github.com 2>&1 | python -c "import sys,json; r=json.loads(sys.stdin.read().splitlines()[0]); assert r['ok']==True, r; print('SSRF-blocked test OK')"

turndown.comment: Provided by DSH itself (`@deepseek-ai/dsh` declares it as a dep). install.py creates a directory junction `~/.dsh/plugins/web-fetch-local/node_modules` -> DSH's node_modules so Node module resolution finds them. If the junction is missing, the tool degrades to text-only mode.

@joplin/turndown-plugin-gfm.comment: Provided by DSH itself. Same junction mechanism as `turndown`.

optionalDependencies_comment: Python `extruct` (pip install) is optional. When present, the tool extracts JSON-LD / Microdata / OpenGraph / RDFa / Microformat from the page and surfaces them as `metadata` in the result. When absent, `metadata` is null and the tool degrades gracefully.
